written_after_exposure.why: the frozen universe is a list of CURRENT tickers; whether a current ticker retrieves its own pre-rename history is a source-capability question that P1-P9 never asked, and getting it wrong would silently blank part of a security's history
written_after_exposure.no_new_ground_truth: fixture F5 (FB -> META, CUSIP unchanged) was confirmed from Meta investor relations and sealed in SP500_PIT_FIXTURES_V1 long before this

classification_buckets.CURRENT_TICKER_BACKFILLED: META retrieves the pre-change session; the current ticker reaches its own past
classification_buckets.TICKER_AT_TIME: FB is required before 2022-06-09 and META after; requests are keyed by the ticker as it stood
classification_buckets.AMBIGUOUS: both tickers return data for a session and the payloads conflict

consequences.CURRENT_TICKER_BACKFILLED: the current 503-ticker map may be used as-is for the whole window — as CONFIRMED vendor behaviour, not as an assumption
consequences.TICKER_AT_TIME: canonical identity becomes (security_id, massive_ticker_at_time, effective_from, effective_to) and the full ticker history of all 503 securities must be frozen from Massive reference data BEFORE ingestion. CIK corroborates issuer identity but is NOT sufficient alone, because a dual-class issuer maps one CIK to several securities.
